objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, or other controlled content subject to creation, editing, release, versioning, and archiving workflows.

attributes.name: documenttype
attributes.description: Category such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or designation of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state such as In Editing, In Review, Released, or Out of Force.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document.

attributes.name: validfrom
attributes.description: Date from which the document is valid.

attributes.name: validuntil
attributes.description: Date after which the document requires validity extension or becomes invalid.

attributes.name: documentabbreviation
attributes.description: Short code prefix for the document type.

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person involved in document management activities with assigned roles and permissions.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Authorization role such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, or Translator.

attributes.name: usergroup
attributes.description: Assigned group for authorization and distribution purposes.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document object that is versioned and released together with its parent document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Release status linked to parent document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number tied to parent document version.

objs.name: additionalinfo
objs.description: A supplementary document object not subject to the parent document's release cycle.

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of publication status.

objs.name: changeproposal
objs.description: A suggested amendment to an existing document created by authorized users without affecting the document's version or release status.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Proposed, Planned, or Completed.

objs.name: validityextensionrequest
objs.description: An automatically generated or manually created request to confirm continued validity of a released document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending, Extended, or Converted to Override.

objs.name: overriderequest
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a released document that no longer has validity.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending, Declared, or Completed.

objs.name: reactivationrequest
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated and archived document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending or Confirmed.

objs.name: distributionlist
objs.description: A collection of users or user groups assigned to receive notifications or acknowledgements for a document.

attributes.name: distributiontype
attributes.description: Type such as Email or Acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A workflow task confirming that a recipient has reviewed and accepted a released document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State such as Pending or Confirmed.

objs.name: translatedversion
objs.description: A language-specific version of a released document subject to separate review and release workflow.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Target language of the translation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Release status of the translated version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: An electronic record documenting approval by a workflow participant.

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who applied the signature.

attributes.name: timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time of signature.

objs.name: audittrail
objs.description: A system-maintained record of all changes and approvals for a document ensuring complete traceability.

attributes.name: activity
attributes.description: Type of action recorded such as creation, modification, or release.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initial creation of a new document object with selection of document type and optional template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modification of document content through an integrated editor with support for multiple Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Adding or updating standardized and custom attributes and properties of a document.

evts.name: attach_file
evts.description: Upload of an external file or generation of content based on standard Office formats to a document.

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic conversion of document content to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronic signature by a workflow participant (author, reviewer, releaser) confirming approval.

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiation of the review step in the release workflow by the author or co-author.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Technical and formal evaluation of document content and properties by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Final approval and publication of a document by assigned releasers, making it visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of a released document to the addressed reader audience.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled sub-document (Attachment) to a parent document subject to linked versioning.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Inclusion of a supplementary non-critical document element not subject to the parent's release cycle.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submission of a suggested amendment to an existing document by an authorized user.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Designation of a change proposal for implementation in a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Documentation of resolution and completion of a change proposal by the document author.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatic or manual initiation of a validity review process when document validity is approaching expiration.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirmation by authorized users that a document remains valid; updates the valid-until date.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of a new version of a released document with retention and potential adaptation of prior data.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiation of invalidation and archiving process for a document determined to have no further validity.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Formal invalidation and archiving of a document, revoking all authorizations except for the archive group.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Submission by authorized Business Admin to restore validity of a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restoration of an archived document to active status with metadata and authorizations preserved, enabling new release.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assignment of users or user groups to receive email or acknowledgement notifications for document release.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: Automatic notification to assigned users upon document release via email distribution.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatic request for active confirmation of document receipt by assigned users in the distribution list.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Positive confirmation by a recipient that they have reviewed a document requiring acknowledgement.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Creation of a language-specific version of a released document requiring separate review and approval.

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Technical and formal evaluation of translated document content by assigned reviewers.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approval and publication of a translated document version making it visible to users in the target language.

evts.name: assign_client_visibility
evts.description: Specification of which clients can access a particular document in a multi-client system.

o2o.description: A Document may contain one or more Attachments which are released with the parent document.
A Document may contain one or more AdditionalInfo elements supplementing its content.
A ChangeProposal belongs to and references a specific Document for proposed amendments.
A ValidityExtensionRequest is created for and linked to a Document requiring validity confirmation.
An OverrideRequest is created for and targets a specific Document for invalidation.
A ReactivationRequest references a previously invalidated Document for reactivation.
A Document has an assigned DistributionList defining recipients for notifications and acknowledgements.
A Document may have one or more TranslatedVersions in different languages.
A Document may reference or link to other Documents through attributes such as References.
Each Document maintains an AuditTrail recording all modifications and approvals.
A DistributionList contains assigned Users or User Groups for distribution purposes.
A ChangeProposal has an associated User author who created the proposal.
An Acknowledgement is assigned to a specific User to confirm document receipt.
A Signature is created by a User participating in document approval workflow.
A TranslatedVersion derives from and is linked to a parent Document in the original language.
